mentions.name: id-le
mentions.description: A browser-based video game in which players can build their own worlds. The brains of the game's creatures are a small language model plus a harness that runs in the player's browser. The project is open source.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A video game in which players can build their own worlds. The brains of the creatures in the video game are a small language model + harness that runs in your browser: http://id-le.com

It’s open source: https://github.com/nicobrenner/id-le
